==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I attained lucidity through self induced sleep paralysis. I returned to the elf village to find the Death Witch. (The Elf Village is made up of huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.)
I was shocked to discover that she has become their ruler. (The Death Witch has pale skin, straight black hair, red eyes, long tattered black robes, a belt made of skulls, and a wooden staff that radiates with purple energy.)
She is using her magic to instantly eliminate anyone who opposes her and I don't know how to beat her.
